value.rationale: A complete sharp parameter classification answers a natural design question for an explicitly published adaptive stiff integrator: does an inner-forward-Euler stable dissipative spectrum remain stable after the full projective step? A threshold of inner/outer ratio 1/9 separates gap-free scalar damping from two macroscopically wide instability holes; it quantifies the cost of large time-scale separation, gives exact neutral modes at transition, and the band asymptotics provide a direct analytic benchmark for multiscale spectrum selection. This is a full natural interval classification, not an arbitrary isolated computation. No generalization to complex or nonlinear dynamics is claimed.
